feature: The View | Edit switch, and every segmented choice, is the design system's segmented control
summary: The View | Edit switch at the top right of a recording is now the component from the design system page: a soft capsule with one raised plate that slides to your pick. Every other row of side-by-side choices in the app (panel rows, the colour picker, the export sheets, the history bar) is the same control.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no switch changed from its default. Open any screen recording.

try.do: Open a screen recording. It opens in View: look at the View | Edit switch at the top right of the title bar.
Click Edit on the switch and watch the plate slide across to it.
Press Cmd-1, then Cmd-2, then E, and watch the plate follow each time.
Rest the pointer on View: its tooltip names it and its key.
Draw a rectangle, group it (Cmd-G) and pick Stack in the panel's Arrangement row: the same control, filling the row.
Compare every size and state side by side with the component page: the app first, then the page.
The page's Sizes and States sections, for the comparison.
The same app sheet in light mode.

evaluate: Does the View | Edit switch now read as the same control as the rows in the panel?
Is the title bar switch the right height beside the panel button (24pt, the small size), or should it be taller?
Is the picked plate easy enough to find on the dark title bar?
Does the plate's slide feel quick and settled, or does its small overshoot feel bouncy?
rough: The title bar switch uses the small 24pt size so it matches the panel button beside it; the page says a tool bar switch is 32pt, but a Mac title bar is only 28pt tall.
Focus: the ring sits round the picked plate, because arrow keys move the pick. The page's picture rings one segment that is not picked.

In a panel the segments take equal columns when their words fit an equal share, and otherwise each keeps its own width and shares out the rest, so a long word is never cut while the row has room for it. The page draws strict equal columns.
When the words would be cut short the control becomes a dropdown, and that dropdown's face is 24pt tall where the page's menu trigger stays 28pt.
Panel rows are now 28pt tall, the page's panel size, where the system control was about 20pt. Sections with several of them are a little taller than before.
In walks, the Across alignment segments are now pressed as Left, Center and Right (their tooltip words) rather than the system's 'align left' names; five walks were updated.
The pictures of every state come from Scripts/segmented-gallery.swift (an offscreen render of the shipped control), not from the running app; the title bar pictures are real captures.
